# Movico

> Riyadh's leading corporate video production company. Brand films, event coverage, corporate videos & media production across Saudi Arabia and the GCC.

## About

Movico is a Riyadh-based media production studio specialising in corporate videos, event coverage, and brand films — engineered for maximum commercial impact across Saudi Arabia and the GCC. Based in Wadi Laban, Riyadh.

## Services

- Video Production — Corporate videos, brand films, and commercials
- Event Coverage — Conferences, product launches, and brand activations
- Brand Identity — Strategic brand systems and visual design
- Photography — Corporate and commercial photography
- Spatial & Booth Design — Exhibition environments
- Interior Design — Commercial space visualisation
- Social & Digital Content — Performance-driven content for all platforms
